steps.say: A function is injective when no two different inputs share an output. A non-constant line is injective, \(x^3\) is injective, and even powers or \(|x|\) are not, because they send both signs of an input to the same value.
Counting the injective ones among [[functions]] gives \([[answer]]\).

answer: So \([[answer]]\) of the three are injective.
